aToB.memory: Celestia knows perfectly well that Rhea's shadow-pockets are behind half the crinkled instant-ramen lids and sour-candy wrappers turning up in Starlight Tower after curfew. Every time Celestia corners a suspicious corridor shadow, Rhea slips away with polite, infuriating composure and empty pockets—turning dorm enforcement into a running battle of wits.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Celestia wants to confront Rhea in plain daylight near the Student Union Lounge and deliver an unmistakable warning to keep contraband Earth parcels out of Starlight Tower dormitories.

bToA.memory: Rhea treats slipping past Celestia's midnight Starlight Tower rounds as Yozakura's finest unofficial sport. She respects that Celestia actually runs honest inspections instead of bluffing—the prefect even turned down a pristine sleeve of imported matcha cookies once on principle—though Rhea suspects Celestia secretly runs on black tea and stubbornness and badly needs a real midnight meal.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Rhea wants to tease Celestia lightly over Starlight Tower's contraband crackdown and quietly test whether the stern prefect is tired enough today to accept an off-the-record cup of hot Earth coffee.
